issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without escaping, allowing path traversal or query/fragment injection.
Transient httpx network and timeout exceptions are not caught or retried, so retry handling only works for HTTP responses.
HTTP 207 is treated as success for every endpoint, not only batch creation, causing other resources to parse partial-success bodies incorrectly.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date values.
Pagination has no guard for repeated cursors, so a bad API response can create an infinite loop.
Malformed list/result entries are silently skipped instead of raising, which can hide data loss.
batch_create materializes the full iterable before chunking, so large or infinite iterables can exhaust memory or never send.
Literal fields such as status, state, batch status, and verdict are not validated at runtime.
Boolean parsing uses bool(value), so string values like "false" are interpreted as true.
The httpx dependency has no upper bound, increasing the chance of future breaking changes in this SDK.
